title: Verify project environment delivery through real Claude and ACP spawn adapters
outcome: Disposable provider fixtures verify selected project values reach children through existing Claude/ACP spawn adapters, beyond direct AppliedProjectEnvironment::apply coverage.
acceptance: Drive existing Claude and ACP runtime spawn adapter fixtures with distinguishable selected and inherited values and verify the disposable child receives the selected value, preserving local-project isolation.

Keep fixtures deterministic and self-contained using existing spawn/runtime owners; expose no values in client state/diagnostics, make no global environment changes, and require no live provider service.
